decision: Ship 22 native JSX accessibility checks, 11 upstream Stylelint checks and six narrow custom checks at warning; retain conditional browser review criteria. No autofix is provided for the custom checks.

changes: Omit native label-has-associated-control: prop-forwarding label adapters cannot prove a missing association.
Omit native role-has-required-aria-props: render-prop primitives may supply the missing attributes; verify final DOM instead.
Use maintained media-query-no-invalid ignoreFunctions for custom/theme compilation; keep standard invalid-query detection.

boundaries: Every initial finding was inspected. Zero final natural positives do not establish field precision or recall.

Twelve public paired examples verify the five Oxlint rules; positive, negative and near-miss RuleTester cases and CSS tests provide activation evidence. They are curated examples, not independent field observations.

HTML/Astro templates, CSS-in-JS, referenced handlers, custom components, cross-file ownership, external cascade, computed DOM and actual browser interaction remain outside the stated static boundaries.

Private corpus source, paths, revisions and identifying hashes remain local. CSS bytes were verified against the declared archived Git commits; JavaScript digests were verified before and after isolated batches.
No formatter convergence claim is made for the six nonfixing custom rules; immutable corpus scans prove they did not rewrite source.

performance.scope: Only the newly selected JSX checks versus the same parser/plugin with those checks off; not the complete Standards preset or typed analysis.
performance.selection: Deterministic random sample, seed 0, from the same immutable private corpus.
performance.limitations: Fresh processes on a warm filesystem; no shared cache eviction or persistent warmed-engine measurement. time reports maximum process RSS, not aggregate process-tree peak.
performance.assessment: The measured incremental median is 0.37 seconds and 19,472 KiB for this 250-file sample. It is a bounded cost observation, not a full-preset speed or memory guarantee.
